d: Gen Z is falling in love with a 13-year-old iPhone! Apple's colourful iPhone 5C, once considered outdated, is making a surprising comeback thanks to its grainy, imperfect retro camera. Searches for the device have reportedly skyrocketed as young buyers embrace the Y2K aesthetic and reject today's ultra-polished smartphone photography. From blurry pictures to nostalgic gadgets, discover why imperfect technology is suddenly the new cool, how much the iPhone 5C costs today, and why its outdated software makes it risky to use as your everyday phone. Is nostalgia beating technology? Apparently,…
